name: ds-web
description: Live web search and page fetch for DeepSeek models on Codex, backed by DeepSeek's own Search/Fetch API. Kept invisible to GPT models, with Windows support.

interface.shortDescription: Give DeepSeek models real web search and page fetching
interface.longDescription: Bundles two MCP tools (web_search, web_fetch) that call DeepSeek's official Search and Fetch APIs. Three layers keep them DeepSeek-only: a profile-scoped enable switch, a SessionStart notice telling non-DeepSeek models not to call them, and a PreToolUse hook that denies any call that tries anyway. Ships POSIX and Windows installers.
